# Q3: Reproduce PCA Plots from the Paper Exam
```{r}
install.packages("Rtsne")
install.packages("umap")
install.packages("factoextra")
install.packages("cluster")
install.packages("dendextend")
library(tidyverse)
library(Rtsne)
library(umap)
library(factoextra)
library(cluster)
library(dendextend) 
```

 

```{r}
vars <- data %>% select(year, ghsl_water_surface,
                      ghsl_built_pre_1975, ghsl_built_1975_to_1990, ghsl_built_1990_to_2000,
                      ghsl_built_2000_to_2014, ghsl_not_built_up, ghsl_pop_density,
                      landcover_crops_fraction, landcover_urban_fraction,
                      landcover_water_permanent_10km_fraction, landcover_water_seasonal_10km_fraction,
                      nighttime_lights, dist_to_capital, dist_to_shoreline)
```

```{r}
# PCA
pca <- prcomp(scale(vars), center = TRUE)

# Contributions (loadings)
loadings <- as.data.frame(pca$rotation[, 1:4]) %>%
  rownames_to_column("Variable") %>%
  pivot_longer(-Variable, names_to = "PC", values_to = "Contribution")

ggplot(loadings, aes(x = Variable, y = Contribution, fill = PC)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "dodge") +
  theme_minimal() +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(title = "Contributions aux PC1 à PC4", y = "Valeur des composantes principales")
```

```{r}
# Second Graph: Contribution Plot for PC1 and PC2

pc1_vars <- c("landcover_urban_fraction", "ghsl_not_built_up", "ghsl_pop_density", "nighttime_lights",
              "ghsl_built_pre_1975", "ghsl_built_1975_to_1990", "ghsl_built_1990_to_2000", "ghsl_built_2000_to_2014")

pc2_vars <- c("ghsl_water_surface", "landcover_water_permanent_10km_fraction", "landcover_water_seasonal_10km_fraction",
              "ghsl_not_built_up", "ghsl_built_2000_to_2014", "ghsl_built_1990_to_2000",
              "landcover_crops_fraction", "dist_to_capital")

loadings_data <- as.data.frame(pca$rotation)
loadings_abs <- loadings_data %>%
  mutate(Variable = rownames(.)) %>%
  filter(Variable %in% unique(c(pc1_vars, pc2_vars))) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("PC"), names_to = "PC", values_to = "Value") %>%
  filter((PC == "PC1" & Variable %in% pc1_vars) | (PC == "PC2" & Variable %in% pc2_vars)) %>%
  mutate(Positive = ifelse(Value > 0, "True", "False"),
         AbsValue = abs(Value))

ggplot(loadings_abs, aes(x = reorder(Variable, AbsValue), y = AbsValue, fill = Positive)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  facet_wrap(~PC, scales = "free_y") +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("True" = "blue", "False" = "red")) +
  labs(title = "Valeurs absolues PC1 et PC2", y = "Absolute value of contribution", x = "") +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
# Third Graph: PCA Scatter Plot (PC1 vs. PC2) by country
data$pca1 <- pca$x[, 1]
data$pca2 <- pca$x[, 2]
ggplot(data, aes(x = pca1, y = pca2, color = country)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6, size = 2) +
  labs(title = "PCA Scatter Plot (PC1 vs. PC2)", x = "PC1", y = "PC2") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "right") +
  scale_color_discrete(name = "Country")
```

```{r}
# Remove duplicates for t-SNE
dup_indices <- !duplicated(scaled_vars)
scaled_vars_no_dups <- scaled_vars[dup_indices, ]
data_no_dups <- data[dup_indices, ]

# t-SNE
set.seed(123)  # For reproducibility
tsne_result <- Rtsne(scaled_vars_no_dups, dims = 2, perplexity = 30, pca = TRUE)
data_no_dups$tSNE1 <- tsne_result$Y[, 1]
data_no_dups$tSNE2 <- tsne_result$Y[, 2]

```

```{r}
# t-SNE Plot
ggplot(data_no_dups, aes(x = tSNE1, y = tSNE2, color = country)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7) +

  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "right") +
  scale_color_discrete(name = "Country")
```
# Q4. Perform your own Unsupervised Learning analysis on this dataset.
```{r}
library(cluster)
library(factoextra)
library(ggplot2)
library(recipes)
library(dplyr)
```

```{r}
unsup_data <- data %>%
  select(where(is.numeric))
```

```{r}
rec <- recipe(~ ., data = unsup_data) %>%
  step_normalize(all_predictors()) %>%
  prep()

norm_data <- bake(rec, new_data = NULL)
```

```{r}
set.seed(2025)
kmeans_res <- kmeans(norm_data, centers = 3, nstart = 25)

data_clustered <- data %>%
  mutate(cluster = factor(kmeans_res$cluster))
```

```{r}
data_clustered %>%
  group_by(cluster, urban_or_rural) %>%
  summarise(count = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(cluster)

data_clustered %>%
  group_by(cluster, country) %>%
  summarise(avg_wealth = mean(Target), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(cluster, desc(avg_wealth))

```
```{r}
ggplot(data_clustered, aes(x = urban_or_rural, fill = cluster)) +
  geom_bar(position = "dodge") +
  labs(title = "Cluster Distribution by Urban/Rural", x = "Urban or Rural", y = "Count") +
  theme_minimal()

```
```{r}
data_clustered %>%
  group_by(cluster) %>%
  summarise(across(where(is.numeric), mean)) %>%
  pivot_longer(-cluster, names_to = "variable", values_to = "mean_value") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = variable, y = mean_value, fill = cluster)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge") +
  theme_minimal() +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(title = "Cluster-wise Mean of Variables")

```
```{r}
 data_clustered %>%
  count(country, cluster) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = country, y = n, fill = cluster)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "dodge") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
  labs(title = "Cluster Count by Country")

```



```{r}
vars <- data %>% select(ghsl_water_surface, ghsl_built_pre_1975, ghsl_built_1975_to_1990,
                      ghsl_built_1990_to_2000, ghsl_built_2000_to_2014, ghsl_not_built_up,
                      ghsl_pop_density, landcover_crops_fraction, landcover_urban_fraction,
                      landcover_water_permanent_10km_fraction, landcover_water_seasonal_10km_fraction,
                      nighttime_lights, dist_to_capital, dist_to_shoreline)
scaled_vars <- scale(vars)
```

```{r}
# Determine optimal number of clusters using elbow method
wss <- numeric(10)
for (k in 1:10) {
  kmeans_result <- kmeans(scaled_vars, centers = k, nstart = 25)
  wss[k] <- kmeans_result$tot.withinss
}
elbow_data <- data.frame(k = 1:10, wss = wss)
ggplot(elbow_data, aes(x = k, y = wss)) +
  geom_line() + geom_point() +
  labs(title = "Elbow Method for Optimal k", x = "Number of Clusters (k)", y = "Within-Cluster Sum of Squares") +
  theme_minimal()

# Apply K-means with optimal k (e.g., k = 3)
set.seed(123)  # For reproducibility
kmeans_result <- kmeans(scaled_vars, centers = 3, nstart = 25)
data$cluster <- kmeans_result$cluster
```

```{r}
# Evaluate clustering metrics
silhouette_score <- silhouette(kmeans_result$cluster, dist(scaled_vars))[, 3]
avg_silhouette <- mean(silhouette_score, na.rm = TRUE)
bss <- kmeans_result$betweenss
tss <- kmeans_result$totss
bss_ratio <- bss / tss

# Print metrics
cat("Evaluation Metrics for k = 3:\n")
cat(sprintf("Average Silhouette Score: %.3f\n", avg_silhouette))
cat(sprintf("Between-Cluster Sum of Squares Ratio (BSS/TSS): %.3f\n", bss_ratio))
cat(sprintf("Within-Cluster Sum of Squares: %.3f\n", wss[3]))
```

# Q8. Perform a Supervised Learning Analysis on the target (consider it a continuous variable)
```{r}
colSums(is.na(data_split))
```

```{r}
set.seed(2025)
```

```{r}
df <- initial_split(data_split, prop = 2/3, strata = Target)

train_df <- training(df)
test_df  <- testing(df)
```

```{r}
rec <- recipe(Target ~ ., data = train_df) %>%
  step_rm(ID) %>%   
  step_novel(country, urban_or_rural) %>%   
  step_dummy(country, urban_or_rural) %>%   
  step_zv(all_predictors()) %>%   
  step_normalize(all_numeric_predictors()) 
```

```{r}
rec

```


```{r}
# Prepare and apply recipe to training data
prepped_recipe <- prep(rec, training = train_df)
train_processed <- bake(prepped_recipe, new_data = train_df)
test_processed <- bake(prepped_recipe, new_data = test_df)
```

```{r}
X_train <- train_processed %>% select(-Target)
y_train <- train_processed$Target
X_test <- test_processed %>% select(-Target)
y_test <- test_processed$Target
```

```{r}
 library(randomForest)
```


```{r}
# Random Forest Regression Model
rf_model <- randomForest(X_train, y_train, ntree = 100, importance = TRUE)
rf_pred <- predict(rf_model, newdata = X_test)
```

```{r}
rf_mse <- mean((y_test - rf_pred)^2)
rf_rmse <- sqrt(rf_mse)
rf_r2 <- 1 - sum((y_test - rf_pred)^2) / sum((y_test - mean(y_test))^2)
```

```{r}
rf_metrics <- data.frame(
  Metric = c("MSE", "RMSE", "R-squared"),
  Value = c(rf_mse, rf_rmse, rf_r2)
)
print(rf_metrics, row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r}
# Visualization: Predicted vs. Actual
df_plot <- data.frame(
  Actual = y_test,
  Predicted = rf_pred,
  Model = rep("Random Forest", length(y_test))
)
ggplot(df_plot, aes(x = Actual, y = Predicted, color = Model)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1, linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
  labs(title = "Predicted vs. Actual Target Values (Random Forest)", x = "Actual Target", y = "Predicted Target") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "top")
```

```{r}
rf_model <- randomForest(X_train, y_train, ntree = 300, mtry = 6, nodesize = 5, importance = TRUE)

# Predictions
train_pred <- predict(rf_model, newdata = X_train)
test_pred <- predict(rf_model, newdata = X_test)

# Training and Test Metrics
train_mse <- mean((y_train - train_pred)^2)
train_rmse <- sqrt(train_mse)
train_r2 <- 1 - sum((y_train - train_pred)^2) / sum((y_train - mean(y_train))^2)

test_mse <- mean((y_test - test_pred)^2)
test_rmse <- sqrt(test_mse)
test_r2 <- 1 - sum((y_test - test_pred)^2) / sum((y_test - mean(y_test))^2)

# Display metrics
train_metrics <- data.frame(
  Metric = c("MSE", "RMSE", "R-squared"),
  Value = c(train_mse, train_rmse, train_r2)
)
print("Training Set Metrics:")
print(train_metrics, row.names = FALSE)

test_metrics <- data.frame(
  Metric = c("MSE", "RMSE", "R-squared"),
  Value = c(test_mse, test_rmse, test_r2)
)
print("Test Set Metrics:")
print(test_metrics, row.names = FALSE)

# Visualization: Predicted vs. Actual
df_plot <- data.frame(
  Actual = c(y_train, y_test),
  Predicted = c(train_pred, test_pred),
  Dataset = rep(c("Training", "Test"), times = c(length(y_train), length(y_test)))
)
ggplot(df_plot, aes(x = Actual, y = Predicted, color = Dataset)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1, linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
  labs(title = "Predicted vs. Actual Target Values", x = "Actual Target", y = "Predicted Target") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "top")
```

```{r}
library(ranger)
```


```{r}
cv_folds <- vfold_cv(train_processed, v = 5)

num_trees_values <- c(200, 300)
mtry_values <- c(3, 4)  
min_node_size_values <- c(10, 15) 
max_depth_values <- c(5, 10)  
param_grid <- expand.grid(num.trees = num_trees_values, mtry = mtry_values, min.node.size = min_node_size_values, max.depth = max_depth_values)


tuning_results <- data.frame(
  num.trees = numeric(),
  mtry = numeric(),
  min.node.size = numeric(),
  max.depth = numeric(),
  mse = numeric()
)


for (i in 1:nrow(param_grid)) {
  num.trees <- param_grid$num.trees[i]
  mtry <- param_grid$mtry[i]
  min.node.size <- param_grid$min.node.size[i]
  max.depth <- param_grid$max.depth[i]
  
  fold_mse <- numeric(5)
  for (j in 1:5) {
    fold <- cv_folds$splits[[j]]
    train_fold <- analysis(fold)
    valid_fold <- assessment(fold)
    
    X_train_fold <- train_fold %>% select(-Target)
    y_train_fold <- train_fold$Target
    X_valid_fold <- valid_fold %>% select(-Target)
    y_valid_fold <- valid_fold$Target
    
    rf_model <- ranger(Target ~ ., data = train_fold, num.trees = num.trees, mtry = mtry, min.node.size = min.node.size, max.depth = max.depth, importance = "impurity")
    rf_pred <- predict(rf_model, data = X_valid_fold)$predictions
    
    fold_mse[j] <- mean((y_valid_fold - rf_pred)^2)
  }
  
  avg_mse <- mean(fold_mse)
  tuning_results <- rbind(tuning_results, data.frame(num.trees = num.trees, mtry = mtry, min.node.size = min.node.size, max.depth = max.depth, mse = avg_mse))
}


best_params <- tuning_results[which.min(tuning_results$mse), ]
best_num.trees <- best_params$num.trees
best_mtry <- best_params$mtry
best_min.node.size <- best_params$min.node.size
best_max.depth <- best_params$max.depth


final_rf_model <- ranger(Target ~ ., data = train_processed, num.trees = best_num.trees, mtry = best_mtry, min.node.size = best_min.node.size, max.depth = best_max.depth, importance = "impurity")
train_pred <- predict(final_rf_model, data = X_train)$predictions
test_pred <- predict(final_rf_model, data = X_test)$predictions


train_mse <- mean((y_train - train_pred)^2)
train_rmse <- sqrt(train_mse)
train_r2 <- 1 - sum((y_train - train_pred)^2) / sum((y_train - mean(y_train))^2)

test_mse <- mean((y_test - test_pred)^2)
test_rmse <- sqrt(test_mse)
test_r2 <- 1 - sum((y_test - test_pred)^2) / sum((y_test - mean(y_test))^2)


train_metrics <- data.frame(
  Metric = c("MSE", "RMSE", "R-squared"),
  Value = c(train_mse, train_rmse, train_r2)
)
print("Training Set Metrics:")
print(train_metrics, row.names = FALSE)

test_metrics <- data.frame(
  Metric = c("MSE", "RMSE", "R-squared"),
  Value = c(test_mse, test_rmse, test_r2)
)
print("Test Set Metrics:")
print(test_metrics, row.names = FALSE)


df_plot <- data.frame(
  Actual = c(y_train, y_test),
  Predicted = c(train_pred, test_pred),
  Dataset = rep(c("Training", "Test"), times = c(length(y_train), length(y_test)))
)
ggplot(df_plot, aes(x = Actual, y = Predicted, color = Dataset)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1, linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
  labs(title = "Predicted vs. Actual Target Values", x = "Actual Target", y = "Predicted Target") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "top")
```

# Q11. Perform another Supervised Learning Analysis on this new target.
```{r}
set.seed(123)
data_split <- initial_split(data_split, strata = Target, prop = 0.8)
train_data <- training(data_split)
test_data <- testing(data_split)


rec <- recipe(Target ~ ., data = train_data) %>%
  update_role(ID, country, urban_or_rural, new_role = "ID") %>%
  step_dummy(all_nominal_predictors()) %>%
  step_zv(all_predictors()) %>%
  step_normalize(all_numeric_predictors())

```

```{r}
rec

```


```{r}
# Random Forest
rf_spec <- rand_forest(mtry = tune(), trees = tune(), min_n = tune()) %>%
  set_engine("ranger") %>%
  set_mode("classification")

# XGBoost
xgb_spec <- boost_tree(mtry = tune(), trees = tune(), learn_rate = tune()) %>%
  set_engine("xgboost") %>%
  set_mode("classification")

```

```{r}
ctrl <- control_grid(save_pred = TRUE, save_workflow = TRUE)
folds <- vfold_cv(train_data, v = 5, strata = Target)

# Workflow
rf_workflow <- workflow() %>% add_model(rf_spec) %>% add_recipe(rec)
xgb_workflow <- workflow() %>% add_model(xgb_spec) %>% add_recipe(rec)

# Grid
rf_grid <- grid_regular(mtry(range = c(3, 7)), trees(range = c(100, 300)), min_n(range = c(5, 15)), levels = 3)
xgb_grid <- grid_regular(mtry(range = c(3, 7)), trees(range = c(100, 300)), learn_rate(range = c(0.01, 0.2)), levels = 3)

# Tuning
metrics <- metric_set(roc_auc, accuracy, sens, yardstick::spec)

rf_tuned <- tune_grid(
  rf_workflow,
  resamples = folds,
  grid = rf_grid,
  control = ctrl,
  metrics = metrics
)
xgb_tuned <- tune_grid(
  xgb_workflow,
  resamples = folds,
  grid = xgb_grid,
  control = ctrl,
  metrics = metrics
)
```

```{r}
collect_metrics(rf_tuned)
collect_metrics(xgb_tuned)



```

```{r}
rf_preds <- collect_predictions(rf_tuned)
xgb_preds <- collect_predictions(xgb_tuned)
```

```{r}
model_stack <- stacks()

 
model_stack <- model_stack %>%
  add_candidates(rf_tuned) %>%

  blend_predictions()

 
model_stack <- model_stack %>%
  fit_members()



```

```{r}

  bind_cols(predict(model_stack, test_data, type = "prob")) %>%
  bind_cols(test_data %>% select(Target))
```
